goal: Restructure Admin Inbox around active conversation and customer context
context: P1 begins only after INBOX-20261020-001 passes its visual acceptance gate. Continue current uncommitted Admin refinements; preserve existing behavior and data.
requirements: Make active conversation the primary workspace; remove duplicate navigation and redundant metric/header layers
Organize inbox list, conversation, customer 360/order context, AI activity, and channel health into a clear responsive hierarchy
Provide meaningful loading, empty, error, offline, assigned, unread, and human-handoff states
Ensure selecting a conversation updates messages, customer data, channel, and order consistently; keep composer, quick replies, and primary actions usable
Review 1440px, 1024px, and 390px layouts, keyboard operation, focus, contrast, and reduced-motion
acceptance_criteria: At desktop, the active conversation is visually dominant without losing customer context or channel status
At tablet/mobile, panels collapse into purposeful views/drawers and controls remain reachable without horizontal page overflow
No duplicate nav, overlapping panes, clipped composer, dead primary actions, or mismatched customer/order data
Document screenshots and route/interactions reviewed before starting P2
